reason: Owner report 2026-11-18 (RIZAL-COMMIS): 'dili ka dispatch to branch' with the role-limitation page, and the branch not seeing the DR number set at dispatch.
text: A production_in_charge can only dispatch from the commissary sheet OR from the dispatch modal - both must be on the role allowlist. The modal payload carries the DR; the sheet-entry payload does not, and the sheet modal has no DR field for a NEW entry at all (the only DR input lives inside branch-cell-edit-fields). So blocking the modal (the allowlist admitted dispatch only when sheet_entry/source=daily_sheet was present) left the operator no way to send a DR, and the branch received every load as NO DR: 7319 of 8137 commissary deliveries have a NULL dr_number.
